data.summary: The fifth instance of the family G-001 found four of: modules/gsd_x/goal/sweep.py defines set_autonomous(), and no command an operator can type reaches it. A goal therefore cannot be marked autonomous except from Python, so the unattended sweep -- which refuses any goal that is not marked -- can never be given one through the product. G-002 drove its gates through reconcile --apply instead, which calls the same driver and does not consult the flag. DELIBERATELY NOT FIXED: this goal measures whether the engine needed changing, and quietly adding a command would have destroyed the measurement it exists to take.
